title: Prompt Repetition Experiments
description: Pilot series (Exp1 to Exp4, exploratory) and a pre-registered confirmatory experiment (Exp5) testing whether prompt repetition, a verbatim second copy of the instructions, improves the task success of non-reasoning LLM agents in multi-step pipelines. Exp5 runs two models with n=20 per arm and model under executable scoring and finds no effect. Identifies ceiling effects, rubric-runner co-design failure and judge disagreement as evaluation failure modes. Version 1.1.0 holds the Exp5 pre-registration; version 1.2.0 adds the Exp5 main-run data. Supplementary dataset for: Clouatre, H. (2026). Ceiling Effects and Convergence: Null Results for Instruction Repetition in LLM-Agent Pipelines. Preprint: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20039271
